Name: YogaDNS 简体中文内置翻译

Items.Translation: 使用 TCP 代替 UDP
DNS 中继无需额外设置。

Items.Original: DNS server stamps encode all the parameters required to connect to a DNS server as a single string that is formatted as URL and starts with sdns://
Items.Translation: DNS Stamp 将连接 DNS 服务器所需的全部参数编码为一个 URL 格式的字符串，并以 sdns:// 开头。

Items.Original: Drag and Drop DNS servers from the list to add them into a pool.\nA random server from the pool will be used for each request.
Items.Translation: 将列表中的 DNS 服务器拖入服务器池。\n每次查询会从池中随机选择一台服务器。

Items.Original: Ignore the rule when its network interface is down.
Items.Translation: 当关联的网络接口断开时忽略此规则。

Items.Original: Rules are processed from top to bottom. Use Up/Down buttons at the right to change the order.\nUse check boxes to enable/disable a rule.
Items.Translation: 规则按从上到下的顺序处理。使用右侧的上移/下移按钮调整优先级。\n通过复选框启用或禁用规则。
请求并验证所有 DNSSEC 签名

Items.Original: URLs with the DNS server list:
Start with an empty configuration. \nAll queries will be unaltered.
Items.Translation: 从空白配置开始。\n所有 DNS 查询将保持原样。

Items.Original: Import servers from the web, test and select.
Items.Translation: 从网络导入服务器，检测后选择可用项。

Items.Original: Import from a YogaDNS configuration file.
Items.Translation: 从 YogaDNS 配置文件导入。

Items.Original: The wizard will help you with the configuration.
Items.Translation: 此向导将协助你完成初始配置。

Items.Original: Use this provider for all queries
Items.Translation: 所有查询均使用此提供商

Items.Original: Automatically monitor DNS servers and use the best one.
Items.Translation: 自动监测 DNS 服务器并使用当前表现最佳的一台。

Items.Original: On each request use a random DNS server from the pool.
Items.Translation: 每次查询都从服务器池中随机选择一台。

Items.Original: Use network interface that has the following attribute:
Items.Translation: 仅使用符合以下条件的网络接口：

Items.Original: Clear DNS cache on configuration change
Items.Translation: 配置变更后清空 DNS 缓存

Items.Original: Intercept DNS packets injected by third party filters
Items.Translation: 拦截第三方过滤器注入的 DNS 数据包

Items.Original: Block plain DNS over TCP from System Resolver
Items.Translation: 阻止系统解析器发出的明文 TCP DNS 查询

Items.Original: Override TTL to match the following range
Items.Translation: 将 TTL 限制在以下范围内

Items.Original: Do not show this message again
All users on this computer\n(require administrator)
Items.Translation: 此计算机上的所有用户\n（需要管理员权限）

Items.Original: Import an existing configuration from a file\nImport Configuration
Items.Translation: 从文件导入已有配置\n导入配置

Items.Original: Open log folder in File Explorer\nOpen Log Folder
Items.Translation: 在文件资源管理器中打开日志文件夹\n打开日志文件夹

Items.Original: Export current configuration to a file\nExport Configuration
Items.Translation: 将当前配置导出到文件\n导出配置

Items.Original: Start the program automatically when Windows starts for the current user\nAutostart
Items.Translation: 当前用户登录 Windows 时自动启动程序\n随系统启动

Items.Original: Open the list of DNS servers\nDNS Servers
Items.Translation: 打开 DNS 服务器列表\nDNS 服务器
打开解析规则\n解析规则

Items.Translation: 界面日志仅显示错误\n仅错误

文件日志记录详细信息\n详细

Items.Original: On start check for the new version of the program\nCheck for Product Updates on Startup
Items.Translation: 启动时检查 YogaDNS 新版本\n启动时检查更新

Items.Original: Show icon in the System Tray and hide the main window when closed\nIcon in The System Tray
Items.Translation: 在系统托盘显示图标，关闭主窗口时将其隐藏\n最小化到系统托盘

Items.Original: The wizard helps to configure YogaDNS\nConfiguration Start Wizard
Items.Translation: 通过向导配置 YogaDNS\n配置向导

Items.Original: Enable broken_query_padding option for all DNSCrypt servers
Items.Translation: 为所有 DNSCrypt 服务器启用 broken_query_padding 选项

Items.Original: Use small font in the log window\nSmall Font
Items.Translation: 日志窗口使用小号字体\n小号字体

Items.Original: Use large font in the log window\nLarge Font
Items.Translation: 日志窗口使用大号字体\n大号字体
